svg.title: STAR-EN: prediction and risk stratification workflow
svg.desc: One connected diagram: source and target cohorts, six molecular layers and training-only preparation, SAT-EN and LSAT-EN with binary and Cox branches, convergence to held-out risk scores, then risk groups and RMST and molecular correlations. Embedded mini-plots are saved Overall RSF illustrations, not LSAT estimates.
svg.text: AML application: White source → Black target; endpoint defined as OS or EFS
Training-only QC → imputation & scaling → matched source / target inputs
All supplied features enter the public package; EN shrinkage occurs during fitting.
Single / few layers; a simpler borrowing structure
LT(β) + PEN(β) + ½ Σg τg ‖βg − β̂Sg‖²₂
Binary or time-to-event predictions → descriptive downstream analyses
Embedded mini-plots illustrate saved Overall RSF analyses; they are not LSAT-EN estimates.
Borrowing structure is selected by validation, not guaranteed by the number of omics layers.
